title: Silver's Suspicious Stew Indicator
description: Ever wanted a way to easily tell in a fight which suspicious stew is good or bad?
body:
# Description
Ever wanted a easy way to tell which effects a suspicious stew will give?

Well, this texture pack changes that!

With 2 versions that you can choose:
1st Version: Gives the potion color to the suspicious stew's color tint.
2nd Version: Gives red to all suspicious stew with bad or negative effects and Blue of positive effects.

# Preview
### 1st:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cb78f0f858dd4c5171be75e6e5d0d77f4d25a64.png)

### 2nd:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe4acc1f70b70ac50e457d4a162df59362407131.png)


These suspicious stew layout is using the same one from the [Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Suspicious_Stew#Food)!

# Limitations:
Do note that this will only work with the vanila suspicious stew effects. Ones added in other mods or Datapack that have a value different from vanila will not work.
